name: EMPRESS OF RUST: Shelf Survival Sim
description: A brutally realistic BCI-integrated survival sim that drops players into a procedurally generated Shelf district with nothing — no chrome, no contacts, no Quanta — and tasks them with building a life over a simulated year. Developed by a single anonymous coder known only as 'Tetsuya-Obi,' the game uses real GLMZ economic models and actual corponation policy data to simulate poverty with clinical accuracy. Tier 4 and 5 players who played it as a curiosity began funding Shelf advocacy organizations at measurably higher rates, prompting corponation lobbying groups to attempt a suppression campaign.
story_hooks: Tetsuya-Obi's identity is about to be uncovered by a corponation investigator — but the investigator has been playing EMPRESS OF RUST for three weeks and is having a crisis of conscience.
A Tier 5 executive who played the game on a dare is now secretly funneling Quanta into Shelf infrastructure projects, and someone in their organization wants to know why.
The game's economic model predicted a Shelf district collapse six months before it happened — and someone wants to know if Tetsuya-Obi has a model for the next one.
